Semantic Scholar is a research tool for scientific literature. It is developed at the Allen Institute for AI and was publicly released in November 2015. [ 2 ] Semantic Scholar uses modern techniques in natural language processing to support the research process, for example by providing automatically generated summaries of scholarly papers. [ 3 ] The Semantic Scholar team is actively researching the use of artificial intelligence in natural language processing , machine learning , human–computer interaction , and information retrieval . [ 4 ]
